issues.description: Script establishes a WebSocket connection to garticphone.com and sends drawing packets, which may include user-generated drawing data.
issues.recommendation: Ensure only intended drawing data is sent; avoid sending sensitive or unintended user information.

issues.description: Script grants GM_xmlhttpRequest but does not use it in the code. Unused high privilege.
issues.recommendation: Remove unused GM_xmlhttpRequest grant to minimize attack surface.

issues.description: Script grants unsafeWindow, which can expose internal variables to the page context and vice versa.
issues.recommendation: Review necessity of unsafeWindow; restrict usage if possible.

issues.description: Script uses fetch to load external scripts and resources, but only from garticphone.com domain.
issues.recommendation: Ensure fetch is not used to load from untrusted domains.

issues.description: Script dynamically modifies and injects game scripts via Proxy on Node.prototype.appendChild, but only for scripts containing 'draw' in their src.
issues.recommendation: Carefully validate injected code and avoid introducing vulnerabilities.

issues.description: Script uses setTimeout with string arguments in sendPackets function.
issues.recommendation: Replace setTimeout(string) with setTimeout(function) to avoid code injection risks.

summary: 该脚本主要通过 WebSocket 向 garticphone.com 发送自动绘图数据，未发现明显的隐私采集行为。存在远程代码执行风险（动态修改脚本、setTimeout 字符串用法），以及权限滥用（未使用的 GM_xmlhttpRequest、unsafeWindow）。未检测到代码混淆或 DOM XSS。整体风险为中等，建议优化权限申请和远程代码执行方式。
